name: single_revolute
description: One arm on a revolute joint about the robot's left-right axis.

name: prismatic
description: One carriage on a vertical slider.

name: nested_chain
description: Turret on the drivetrain, hood on the turret, one camera on each, and a measured frame. Mirrors the 2026 robot.

name: coupled
description: Two-stage cascade elevator (carriage mated to stage 1, mimic relation) with a wrist on the carriage. Mirrors the 2025 robot.

name: frozen
description: Two movable joints; only one is listed, so the other must be frozen and merged into the base.

name: invalid_two_parents
description: A link with two parent joints, as from a closed linkage. Must fail and name the link.

name: missing_origin
description: No ascope_origin frame. Must fail with a message telling the student to add it on the drivetrain.
